sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool to retrieve transactions listed on the customer's financial account for the last 5 days. Returns transaction count, dates, descriptions, amounts, and flags potentially suspicious or unauthorized charges (e.g. $898.75) for the caller to review.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"financial_account_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the selected financial account","mandatory":false},{"name":"account_number","description":"The account number of the financial account","mandatory":false},{"name":"days_back","description":"Number of days back to look for transactions (default is 5)","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: retrieve_recent_account_transactions
